title: Figure envelope
description: The one contract every guard is really about. Defined once here and referenced by every skill output schema, because a shape restated per skill is a shape that drifts per skill. Every numeric value that leaves a skill wears this envelope.

value.description: The figure as stated, in the units given by unit and scale.

unit.description: What kind of quantity this is. A ratio is not a currency amount with the symbol left off.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Required when unit is currency, forbidden otherwise.

scale.description: The multiplier already applied to value. Required, never defaulted and never inferred downstream: a trial balance in thousands read as units is the failure this field exists to make impossible.

source_id.description: Content hash of the intake document this figure was read from. Must exist in this run's intake manifest - the Provenance Check verifies that; this schema only enforces the shape and refuses provenance that names the system's own reasoning.

not.title: FABRICATED_SOURCE
not.description: An id naming the system's own reasoning rather than a document. Rejected as hard as a missing one - a figure whose source is 'derived' has no source.

locator.description: Where in that document: sheet!range for a workbook, page/table/row for a document. Resolves against the Source Parse Store (P17).

source_version.description: Which version of that source. A client sending a corrected trial balance does not silently rewrite history.

derivation.description: How the figure was arrived at, or null for a figure read directly off the page. Required either way - a figure that will not say whether it was read or computed cannot be tied out.

masked.description: True until the unmask step. A figure leaving a skill is always masked; only deterministic code sets this false.

confidence.description: The producer's self-report. Routes review; it is never evidence, and it never resolves a disagreement.

produced_by.description: skill-name@version, pinned. A figure that cannot name the skill version that produced it cannot be defended.

model_pin.description: The exact model and effort setting, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5 @ effort=high'.

period.description: Explicit period typing. 'the 2023 numbers' is not a period.

derivation.description: The operation and the operands the Recompute Engine re-derives from. 'of' holds locators into the same run's parsed sources, so tie-out can reach the rows without asking the model what they were.
